description.value: The study investigated how calorie information and dieting status modulate reward and control activation, food-preference-related parametric modulation, and representational similarity during food-image evaluation.

value: we predicted that calorie information might modulate both of these systems

spans.text: Specifically, we tested whether the presence of calorie information would simultaneously decrease reward-related activation while increasing activation in regions associated with cognitive control during the evaluation of food images.

description.value: Observational, within-subject fMRI food-evaluation study with dieting-status groups and no assigned intervention.
